name: keyvalet
description: Use API keys, tokens and OAuth accounts without seeing them: secrets stay in the local vault, uses are Touch ID-approved and audited. Detects keys you share or are about to hard-code, and adds /keyvalet-add, /keyvalet-mode, /keyvalet-status, /keyvalet-lock and /keyvalet-audit. Requires the KeyValet install (curl -fsSL https://keyvalet.dev/install.sh | sh).
